mapper.insert: insert into batch_sync_event ( event_type, task_id, source_agent_id, payload, status, retry_count, error_message, created_at, expire_at ) values ( #{eventType}, #{taskId}, #{sourceAgentId}, #{payload}, 'PENDING', 0, null, now(), DATE_ADD(now(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) )
mapper.select: select * from batch_sync_event where status = 'PENDING' and (expire_at is null or expire_at > now()) order by created_at asc limit #{limit} for update skip locked
mapper.update: update batch_sync_event set status = 'PROCESSING' where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
update batch_sync_event set status = 'COMPLETED', processed_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from batch_sync_event where status = 'PENDING' and expire_at is not null and expire_at < now()
